mapper.select: SELECT qr.result_id, q.quiz_id, q.quiz_type, q.difficulty, s.name AS sector_name, q.question, sel.content AS selected_content, cor.content AS correct_content, q.explanation, qr.solved_at FROM quiz_result qr JOIN quiz q ON qr.quiz_id = q.quiz_id JOIN sector s ON q.sector_id = s.sector_id JOIN quiz_choice sel ON qr.selected_choice_id = sel.choice_id JOIN quiz_choice cor ON cor.quiz_id = q.quiz_id AND cor.is_correct = TRUE WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} AND qr.is_correct = FALSE ORDER BY qr.solved_at DESC

SELECT q.quiz_type, CASE q.quiz_type WHEN 1 THEN '호재/악재 판단' WHEN 2 THEN '섹터/밸류체인 파악' WHEN 3 THEN '용어 퀴즈' WHEN 4 THEN '연쇄 문제' END AS quiz_type_name, COUNT(*) AS wrong_count FROM quiz_result qr JOIN quiz q ON qr.quiz_id = q.quiz_id WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} AND qr.is_correct = FALSE GROUP BY q.quiz_type ORDER BY wrong_count DESC

SELECT usq.saved_quiz_id, q.quiz_id, q.quiz_type, q.difficulty, s.name AS sector_name, q.question, usq.memo, usq.saved_at FROM user_saved_quiz usq JOIN quiz q ON usq.quiz_id = q.quiz_id JOIN sector s ON q.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE usq.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY usq.saved_at DESC
